findings.claim: Batch rename plans sidecar carries for every renamed row without checking that the row serves subtitles, so a non-video row that shares a stem with a video carries the video's sidecars away.
findings.impact: A user batch-renames a selection that includes a poster image `movie.jpg` beside `movie.mp4` and `movie.srt`. The video's `movie.srt` is silently moved to `<new stem>.srt`, so `movie.mp4` loses its subtitle track and the image's new name now holds it. The request answers 200 with empty sidecar_errors.
findings.evidence: backend/app/services/fileops.py:1214-1234: `own = sim.own(old_stem)` runs for every file in rename_plan with no `_serves_subtitles(file)` guard. `_sidecar_carry_plan` (fileops.py:488) and `copy_file` (fileops.py:327) both have the guard. The removed `_carry_batch_sidecars` went through `_carry_sidecars`, which returned early for non-serving rows. In the walk-through, `counts[old_stem] -= 1` also takes the video's stem count to 0, so `plan_sidecar_carry` sees owners==1, chooses mode 'move', and finds the target owned by the new stem, so no conflict is raised.
findings.repro: not_reproduced (read only). Walk-through: rows movie.mp4 (video) and movie.jpg (image) in folder a, file a/movie.srt. PUT /api/files/batch/rename with ids=[jpg] and template 'photo_{n}'. The sim's stem_counts are {movie:1}, sim.own('movie') returns [movie.srt], dest_stems is ['photo_1'], and the carry moves movie.srt to photo_1.srt. No test covers it: test_non_video_keeps_same_stem_srt covers only the single rename and has no video beside the file.

bucket_proposal.reason: The sidecar is carried with a row that does not own it under the longest-stem rule (I1), and the owner that did not move stops listing a sidecar it listed before (I3).

findings.proposed_fix: In _validate_no_duplicates, skip the sidecar planning (continue after the held update) when `not _serves_subtitles(file)`. Add a batch-rename test with movie.jpg beside movie.mp4 and movie.srt.

findings.claim: The file page's title rename swallows every failure in a console.error, so a subtitle refusal (409 subtitle_name_taken / subtitle_owner_change, 400 subtitle_extension_reserved) from that entry point shows nothing.
findings.impact: Renaming a video from its own page to a name whose sidecar is taken does nothing visible. The title stays as it was, and the user gets no message or names.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/FileDetail/hooks/useFileDetailData.ts:185-187: `catch (err) { console.error("Failed to rename file:", err); }`. There is no subtitleFailure call and nothing is rethrown to the caller. Spec 185.8 lists 'the file page's title rename' as a rename entry point.
findings.repro: not_reproduced. Read only: the catch path has no UI side effect.

bucket_proposal.reason: I11 says every 185.8 refusal shows a translated message at each listed entry point, and the file page title rename is listed.

findings.proposed_fix: Map the caught error through subtitleFailure(err, te) and toast or rethrow it, so the title editor can show the message.

findings.claim: Drag-and-drop of several files ignores the batch move's sidecar_errors, so a failed carry is never shown at that entry point.
findings.impact: When a carry fails on disk during a multi-file drag-and-drop move, the user sees no 'some subtitles could not be moved' notice. A video can end up without its subtitles, and nothing names the files.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useDragAndDrop.ts:214-221: the `ids.length > 1` branch reads only `answer.errors`. The single-file branch (209-213), SelectionBar and ClipboardProvider all read sidecar_errors.
findings.repro: not_reproduced. Read only: answer.sidecar_errors is never referenced in the batch branch.

bucket_proposal.reason: I16 requires a failed carry to be named in the shown notice.

findings.proposed_fix: After the skipped toast, add `const carried = answer.sidecar_errors ?? []; if (carried.length) toast.error(sidecarErrorMessage(ts, carried));`

findings.claim: The knowledge submodule bump brings a CI change (actions/setup-node node-version 20 to 24, in two jobs) that no touch point or spec item names.
findings.impact: The addon's CI now runs on a different Node major. Users are not affected directly, but the change ships inside a subtitle feature without review of its own, and a pnpm/engine mismatch would show up as an unrelated CI failure.
findings.evidence: addons/knowledge/.github/workflows/ci.yml hunks at lines 144-147 and 240-243 (`node-version: 20` to `24`), included in gitlink 244d875b..7a94f8d7. The touch points name only Editor.tsx and messages/{ja,en}.json in the knowledge repository.
findings.repro: Diff inspection of the submodule range.

bucket_proposal.reason: Scope: an unplanned touch point in a submodule. It breaks no invariant.

findings.proposed_fix: Either list it as a touch point with its reason, or land the Node bump in the knowledge repository as its own change and bump the gitlink separately.

findings.claim: The browser player's caption default and mode handling were rewritten through a new hook, useCaptionTrackSelection.ts, which the touch points do not name and which affects every video, with or without the Subtitles list.
findings.impact: Every video playback now has a new `default` selection (the chosen key instead of index 0) and an effect that rewrites TextTrack modes. A regression there would change caption behaviour on every video, outside the sidecar feature.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/player/hooks/useCaptionTrackSelection.ts (new file) and frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx (track `default={key === captionTrackKey}`). The touch points list only 'the player's track URLs and keys: VideoPlayer.tsx and the shell player's caption hook'.

bucket_proposal.reason: Scope: a new module that the touch-point list does not name. The spec's States section does describe the behaviour.

findings.claim: Several other product files the diff reaches are not in the touch-point list: backend/app/routers/uploads.py, frontend/src/components/UploadProgress.tsx, frontend/src/components/RefusalText.tsx (new), frontend/src/lib/apiError.ts, frontend/src/lib/subtitleErrors.ts (new), frontend/e2e-components/fixtures/app.tsx and subtitlesSection.tsx, frontend/e2e-components/spec-viewport.spec.ts, and mcp-server/src/tools/batch.ts (only 'MCP tool docs' is listed, but the tool description strings in code changed).
findings.impact: Readers of the touch-point list would not know that the upload router now opens a DB session for init, that the upload drawer's error rendering changed, or that the MCP tool descriptions shown to agents changed.
findings.evidence: See the diff for each file. backend/app/routers/uploads.py:33 adds a `db` dependency. UploadProgress.tsx renders errorCode via subtitleErrorMessage. mcp-server/src/tools/batch.ts changes the move_files and copy_files descriptions.
findings.repro: Set difference between the product file list and the touch points.

bucket_proposal.reason: Scope: unplanned touch points. Each is a reasonable consequence of the feature, and none breaks an invariant.

findings.claim: A paste whose only failures are subtitle refusals shows both the generic 'N could not be pasted' toast and the subtitle 'N stayed put' toast, counting the same files twice.
findings.impact: The user sees two error toasts for one refused file. This is confusing but not wrong.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/ClipboardProvider.tsx:169-177: pasteFailed counts all `result.errors`, then moveSkipped counts the subtitle subset again. Spec 185.8 says the subtitle notice sits beside the existing notice 'when other files failed for other reasons'.
findings.repro: not_reproduced. The test ClipboardProvider.subtitleMove only asserts that the subtitle message is contained.

bucket_proposal.reason: I11 is still satisfied. The behaviour only reads differently from the spec's wording.

findings.proposed_fix: Count pasteFailed over the non-subtitle errors only.

findings.claim: copy_file runs the planned sidecar copies only when the caller passes a sidecar_errors list, so a caller that omits the argument silently copies no sidecars.
findings.impact: None today: both callers in backend/app pass a list. A future internal caller would quietly lose I4.
findings.evidence: backend/app/services/fileops.py (copy_file tail): `if sidecar_errors is not None and sidecar_carries: sidecar_errors.extend(move_sidecar_subtitles(sidecar_carries))`. rename_file and move_file run the carry unconditionally.
findings.repro: grep for copy_file callers: only routers/files.py:587 and :1701, and both pass a list.

bucket_proposal.reason: Latent. No current path breaks I4.

findings.proposed_fix: Run move_sidecar_subtitles unconditionally and extend the list only when it is given, as rename_file does.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: Batch rename treats any renamed row, including images and documents, as an owner candidate and carries the same-stem video's sidecars with it.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Batch-renaming a poster or thumbnail image that shares a stem with a video silently moves the video's subtitle to the image's new name.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: The file page's title rename shows nothing when the backend refuses for a subtitle reason.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: A rename from the video page whose sidecar name is taken just doesn't happen, with no message.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: A paste refused only for subtitle reasons shows two error toasts for the same files.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Cut and paste onto a folder with a clashing subtitle shows both the generic 'could not paste' toast and the 'stayed because of a subtitle' toast.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: _ensure_empty_folder_tracked after a subtitle upload tracks only the immediate folder, not intermediate parents created by a nested relative_path.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Uploading a folder tree that contains only subtitles may leave intermediate folders out of their parent's listing until a scan; not verified against the folder listing code.

regression_risks: useCaptionTrackSelection changes the default track and rewrites TextTrack modes for every video, not only videos with managed sidecars.

api.ts moves batchMove, batchCopy, batchRename, createTextFile, renameFile, moveFile and copyFile from fetchJSON to fetchJSONStatus. Errors are now ApiStatusError, an Error subclass with the same message, so message-regex callers should still work. Not checked caller by caller.
physical_delete now skips unlink and the HEIC cache cleanup for any filename with a subtitle extension. That is intended (I9), but it applies to every subtitle-extension row, whatever its file_type.
batch_rename's duplicate check now builds its held-name set from FolderSidecars.all_names (NFC plus lower) instead of _fold_name, which is equivalent in the code read.
test_coverage: No test batch-renames a non-video row beside a same-stem video with a sidecar. F1 would survive the suite.
No test covers the file page title rename's handling of a subtitle refusal (F2).
No test covers sidecar_errors in the multi-file drag-and-drop path (F3). The useDragAndDrop subtitle tests appear to cover only skipped counts, if any exist.
The scanner and upload files.purged tests monkeypatch emit_sync with a fake that accepts drives. The real signature (event_hooks.py:334) accepts drives too, so the fake matches.
Backend tests cover the main refusal, carry, copy and purge paths, including the auto-purge and empty-trash shared-owner cases.
